known_limitations: Loop-carried SSA (OpPhi): emit_for_range does NOT insert OpPhi for loop-carried values (coopmat accumulators, mutable variables in for-loops). This is the root cause of gpu=0.0 in matmul and attention kernels. Required for M3.3 competitive matmul.
matmul_shared_coopmat.axc: single K-block design; multi-K-block accumulation requires OpPhi; deferred to M3.3.

Cross-vendor race honesty gap: AT-1606 barrier claim is unverifiable on NVIDIA (lockstep) or Lavapipe (serial). AMD/Intel required for true race validation (EB.1 gap, documented in DESIGN.md).
